$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the workspace hibernation settings (plans/cmux-next/workspace-hibernation-DESIGN.md): idle workspaces leave memory. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants (WorkspaceHibernationSettings parses them). Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: hibernation
lists.note: Settings > General > Hibernation. WorkspaceHibernation (CmuxNextApp) reads every row; a workspace's Keep Awake (its row's Options menu) wins.

rows.name: enabled
rows.note: On by default (Lawrence 14151: pause idle workspaces and free their memory). Off: nothing hibernates on its own; Hibernate Workspace still works.

help.text: Frees the memory of workspaces you have not used for a while. Terminals and agents keep running; pages and chats come back where they were when you open the workspace.

rows.name: idleMinutes
rows.note: Minutes since the workspace was last shown, printed output, or its agent spoke. 60: an hour away. Memory pressure shortens it (warning 10 minutes, critical 1).

help.text: A workspace hibernates when you have not opened it and nothing in it changed for this many minutes. Pinned workspaces, running commands and agents, and workspaces kept awake never hibernate.

rows.name: hiddenSpaceMinutes
rows.note: Minutes a workspace of a space no window shows waits instead (leo-workspace design/spaces.md, Hibernation and the perf plan); the shorter of this and idleMinutes applies. 15: picked from bench_workspace_hibernation.py (the PR names the run). Memory pressure shortens it the same way.

help.text: When no window shows a space, its workspaces hibernate after this many idle minutes instead. Pinned workspaces, running commands and agents, and workspaces kept awake never hibernate.

rows.name: freeingEnabled
rows.note: Off by default at first (plans/cmux-next/sidebar-recents-and-freeing-DESIGN.md): it ends shell processes, user-visible high-tier behavior. On: a hibernated workspace idle freeingIdleMinutes parks each terminal that sits at an empty prompt (park-tabs); showing it starts a new shell in the same folder under the saved screen.

help.text: Ends the shells of workspaces you have not used for a long time when they sit at an empty prompt. Opening the workspace starts each shell again in the same folder, with its saved screen above it. Pinned workspaces and workspaces kept awake are never freed.

rows.name: freeingIdleMinutes
rows.note: Minutes since the workspace was last shown, printed output, or its agent spoke. 1440: a day away.

help.text: A hibernated workspace's idle shells end after this many minutes without use (1440 is one day).

rows.name: freeingAgents
rows.note: On by default (plans/cmux-next/sidebar-recents-and-freeing-DESIGN.md): a Claude Code or Codex TUI whose agent is idle (no turn, nothing waiting on the person) and whose session id is recorded frees like an idle shell; showing the tab resumes it (claude --resume / codex resume, the respawn prefill rules).

help.text: Also ends Claude Code and Codex sessions that wait for your next message. Opening the tab resumes the same session.

rows.name: freeingRunningCommands
rows.note: never by default: ending a program the person started is not ours to do silently. relaunch: a running command (a dev server, tail -f) ends with its shell; showing the tab types the same command on the new prompt without Return.

help.text: What happens to a command that still runs in a workspace that frees its terminals.

choices.note: The terminal and its workspace's shells keep running.
The command ends; opening the tab types it again without running it.

rows.name: hiddenChatDiscard
rows.note: Off by default (Leo, 2026-11-07: "if it really isn't being used after a while, can't things be more aggressive?"). On: a hidden agent chat's page is let go after hiddenChatDiscardAfterMinutes without browser.hibernation, least recently seen first; memory pressure shortens the wait (warning 5 minutes, critical 10 seconds). Chats whose turn runs or waits on the person, that hold a typed draft, or that are pinned stay. Browser tabs never follow it (HiddenChatPages in CmuxNextHibernation).

help.text: A chat you have not looked at for a while gives back its memory, and comes back where you left it when you open it. Chats that are working, waiting on you or holding a draft are never released.

rows.name: hiddenChatDiscardAfterMinutes
rows.note: Minutes a chat stays hidden before Release Hidden Agent Chats lets its page go. 15 by default. Memory pressure shortens it (warning at most 5 minutes, critical 10 seconds).

help.text: How many minutes a chat stays out of sight before its memory is given back. When the Mac runs low on memory, it happens sooner.
